verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents mobile receipt/memo capture and automated emails to employees when receipts are missing, plus reimbursement submission with receipts attached via the MCP server, but there is no explicit evidence of an 'email receipts in' workflow or automatic matching/attachment of receipts to the correct transaction beyond mobile upload. missing for 10: explicit email-in receipt ingestion, evidence of automatic transaction-matching logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy.
